plan.title: BLOCKER: bug(packaging,content): shipped main.md has 49 of 51 link targets dead in a consumer deposit

narratives.Description: Root main.md is harness-entry content; C1 flatten makes every ./content/ link dead in a deposit. Bound design-critique replaced the naive strip. Census first, then a flatten-aware deposit-time rewrite with an attested marker, tested against a packed fixture via the existing validate-links detector.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Root main.md (bucket content, harnessEntry: true) is the first substantive file a consumer agent is mandated to read. Measured at c6761881 and re-measured on this branch: 51 unique non-URL targets, 47 under ./content/, 49 dead in a replayed deposit. The content package prepack flattens every child of content/ to the payload root, so ./content/languages/python.md does not exist after install.

## Bound contract (read the lean, not the pass-1 body)

Issue body is pass-1. design-critique:triage-ready. Synthesis 5466789356 + lean 5466787287 + critic 5466779496: the naive ./content/ -> ./ strip is not the fix. It addresses 46 of ~200 dead links across 82 shipped files and cannot express ../../main.md (the larger reverse instance of the same flatten).

## Pre-fix census (this worker, before any product edit)

Replayed prepack out of tree. 297 shipped markdown files. 231 broken occurrences / 195 unique-per-file / 81 files. ./content/ spelling: exactly 1 shipped file (main.md, 59 occurrences). Buckets: other parent-escape 101, ./content/ 59, ../main.md family 54, python 12, REFERENCES.md 2, other 3. Naive strip leaves 149 unique. Flatten-aware rewrite (source path -> pack path) leaves only unshipped targets as residuals.

## Design choice

Flatten-aware deposit-time rewrite, not relocating main.md into content/, and not a naive prefix strip. Source checkout keeps source spellings (maintainer). Packed copy rewrites relative links to the deposit layout (consumer) and stamps <!-- deft:deposit-link-rewrite v=1 source=... -->. Relocation of main.md would change the harness-entry rule and ~216 tracked references under a blocks-release-tag deadline; a generalized rewrite covers both directions of the flatten with no new reader-visible source blast radius. Recorded with task decision:write.

## Coordination

- #3958 / PR 3958: REFERENCES.md stays repo-dev and does not ship. Do not retarget main.md's ./REFERENCES.md by assuming that file ships. Point lazy-loading at packs:slice.
- #3957 / PR 3957: live-procedure Python helpers. Does not edit main.md. Leave the three backtick python paths; the one markdown link ./scripts/_precutover.py is a named residual (dead in both trees).
- #3956 / PR 3956: xBRIEF 0.8 canon edits main.md. Do not fight schema-canon; rebase onto origin/master.

## Acceptance (supersedes pass-1 AC1/AC3/AC4 per synthesis)

1. Pack-mapped non-URL link targets in shipped main.md resolve in a staged pack (C1 flatten). #3601 REFERENCES.md is not assumed to ship.
2. Source-checkout main.md still resolves its ./content/ links, or the deposit-time transform is explicit (marker) and tested.
3. Census of every shipped markdown file precedes the fix (done). The rewrite covers pack-mapped targets in every shipped markdown file, not only main.md.
4. Existing validate-links detector runs against a packed fixture and fails closed on unexpected broken links. Named residuals (unshipped targets) are enumerated, not an unnamed remainder.
5. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line.
